title: featurescan configuration
description: Optional project configuration for the featurescan CLI. Explicit command-line flags override values from this file, which override built-in defaults. Save this file as featurescan.config.json (or .js/.ts/.mjs/.cjs/.jsonc/.json5/.yaml/.toml) in the project root, or load it explicitly with --config <path>.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

include.description: Glob patterns for files to scan. When omitted, defaults to the built-in HTML/CSS/JS patterns. A value from this file replaces the built-in list; explicit --include flags replace this value.

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns to exclude. node_modules, .git, and source-map files are always excluded from standalone scanning. Explicit --exclude flags replace this value.

format.description: Manifest output format. `json` emits a sorted array of keys, `lines` emits one key per line, and `detailed` emits feature objects with usage locations and source-map origins.

maxUsages.description: Maximum number of usage locations retained per feature. 0 means unlimited. When omitted, json/lines manifests use 50 and detailed manifests use unlimited.

out.description: Manifest output path. Use `-` for stdout. When a file path is used, the human-readable report is printed to stdout instead of stderr.

verbose.description: Show usage locations, including source-map origins, in the scan report.

progress.description: Show the interactive progress bar on stderr when stderr is a TTY. Use --no-progress on the command line to disable it.

quiet.description: Suppress the human-readable report and progress bar. The manifest is still written.

browsers.description: Browser targets using name@version, name (latest stable), or name@latest. When omitted, every mainstream browser is checked at its latest stable version. Explicit --browser flags replace this value.

items.description: A browser target such as safari@15.6 or chrome@120.

ignoreSources.description: Glob patterns for original source paths to ignore entirely. An issue is ignored only when every usage matches this list. Source-map origins are used when available, otherwise built file paths. Explicit --ignore-source flags replace this value.

dependencySources.description: Additional glob patterns for dependency sources. Issues whose usages all match the built-in `**/node_modules/**` pattern or this list are moved to the Dependencies category. Explicit --dependency-source flags replace this value.

groupByKind.description: Group issue categories under HTML, CSS, and JS headings instead of a flat target-level list.

fail.description: Exit with code 2 when first-party unsupported features are found. Dependency and ignored issues do not trigger this exit.

json.description: Print machine-readable JSON instead of the human-readable report.

quiet.description: Suppress the human-readable report. JSON output is unaffected.
